mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) above 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 6% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a supply-side expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 1% during a recession signals an aggressive monetary easing, which lowers risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS falls below 1% and UNRATE exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both real personal income (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month averages signals strengthening consumer demand, which lifts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both above 6-month averages
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and RSAFS exceed their 6-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate from above 4% to below 3.5% within three months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to margin compression.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls from >4% to <3.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE drops from above 4% to below 3.5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of INDPRO below its 12-month moving average.
